projects.name: Code Lineage
projects.content: Crawls GitHub repositories to generate function and class level code lineage, visualizing dependencies and call graphs across the codebase. Supports running test cases, mocking functions, and comparing branches to help developers understand the impact of changes before merging.

projects.name: Autotyper
projects.content: Autotyper is an application that mimics human typing with an accuracy of 80%. It allows users to simulate typing with optional delays and introduces errors with a specified probability. The application is built with Python and Tkinter, providing an easy-to-use graphical user interface for typing simulation. Used by 200+ users. Among 10+ countries.
